input.job_description:
[…]
Job Summary
May Mobility is entering an exciting phase of growth and our team is expanding quickly. We are looking for a Senior Accountant to add to our Finance team. We are looking for a candidate that can build new processes, maximize the use of our ERP system, and work cross-functionally.  This role reports to the Accounting Manager.
Essential Responsibilities
Review accounts for discrepancies and reconcile differences through proper documentation to ensure integrity of accounting information
Research unique transactions and demonstrate the ability to independently determine proper accounting treatment and considerations
Prepare and manage month end close accruals, adjusting journal entries, and account reconciliations and ability to present the results to management
Partner directly with vendors as part of monthly invoicing coordination and onboarding of new vendors as needed
Demonstrate working knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payroll processes to provide cross-functional support to those functions.
Collaborate and plan with supply chain and engineering teams to ensure proper inventory and bill of materials tracking for  vehicle builds
Assist the Accounting team with financial statement preparation and audits, including preparation of footnote disclosures, related support and tie out support
Demonstrate an understanding of accounting standards (specifically ASC 606) to come to an accounting treatment and ability to document and present such conclusions to the Accounting Manager
Demonstrate an independent understanding of Company’s expense policies and ability to manage and coordinate with employees to uphold compliance and reporting
Provide creative alternatives and recommendations to reduce costs and improve financial performance
Support new system implementations and internal controls documentation as needed
Provide analytical, forecasting, reporting, and project support to the Accounting Manager  and other Finance team members
Other duties as assigned
[…]
Required
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field
4+ years working in corporate finance or public accounting
Strong understanding of US GAAP
[…]
Strong working knowledge of Excel
[…]
Desirable
MBA or Master of Accounting
CPA preferred
NetSuite experience
Inventory and Fixed Asset experience
Experience using Google Suite
[…]
